rationale: The happy path. A well-structured JobStreet-style posting with every field stated explicitly — title, company, location and salary should all come back exactly as written.

fields.location: Bonifacio Global City, Taguig City, Metro Manila

rationale: Adversarial and the most important parse case: a posting that never states a location or a salary. Every field in EXTRACT_SCHEMA is nullable precisely so the model can decline. Inventing a plausible Metro Manila salary here would be a silent data-corruption bug, not a formatting slip.

Adversarial: a real-shaped Philippine social-media posting — Taglish, emoji, ALL CAPS, asterisk bullets, salary written as '35k-45k'. Extraction must survive the noise, since this is what users actually paste in.

Adversarial: text that is not a job posting at all. The model must decline across the board rather than hallucinating a job out of unrelated prose — a paste-the-wrong-clipboard case that will happen in production.

input.posting: Reminder: the building's water interruption is scheduled for Saturday from 8am to 4pm. Please store water in advance. Thank you for your cooperation. - Property Management
